name: TMDB Provider
description: Official TMDB metadata provider (BaseMatch). Real metadata.provider.query via TMDB v3 HTTP. Secrets in plugin config/env only — never in this manifest or core.

permissions.reason: Receive metadata.provider.query lookups with recognition-layer context; contribute whitelist fields via sync response.

configSchema.label: TMDB Access Token
configSchema.helpText: TMDB v4/v3 read access token. Stored encrypted; never echoed.

configSchema.label: Preferred language
configSchema.helpText: BCP-47 / TMDB language tag, e.g. zh-CN

configSchema.label: Include adult
configSchema.helpText: Pass through to TMDB search when true
